identity.title: Protocol for the production of high-yielded research-grade AAV vectors in transiently transfected HEK293T cells.

content.abstract: Adeno-associated vector is a platform of choice for delivering genome-editing toolkits, due to its transient and robust expression. Here, we present a protocol for viral production for in vivo use. We describe steps for transfecting producer cells, harvesting virus, and purifying/concentrating viral particles. We then detail procedures for estimating viral titers. This protocol ensures high viral yields and transduction competency and is scalable to meet user-customized production needs. For complete details on the use of this protocol, please refer to Kantor et al.(1).
